content:
maya: quick q — are we confident AbortController/context cancellation semantics are consistent across Node/Python/Go SDKs for streaming responses? seeing a weird leak when client aborts mid-stream
alex: good callout. not entirely — Node uses AbortController, Go uses context.Context, Python has a cancel token pattern w/ generator close. subtle differences around socket teardown and retry logic
samir: can you paste repro? maybe the runtime retry is reopening streams after abort
maya: repro snippet (node):
```
const ac = new AbortController();
fetch('/v1/stream', { signal: ac.signal })
  .then(r => r.body.getReader())
  .then(reader => { /* read chunks */ })
setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 2000);
```
client sees stream closed but runtime logs show a lingering session for ~30s
ryan: runtime note — we mark connection canceled but we wait for in-flight tokens to flush to avoid partial KV state. that delay used to be 30s default. probably should be shorter when explicit client aborts
olivia: QA reproduced on Python too. using `for chunk in resp.iter_lines()` and then breaking out doesn't always close underlying socket until GC
samir: okay actionable: unify semantics -> explicit client cancel should force immediate connection close and resource reclaim. fallback still allowed for graceful shutdowns
alex: SDK changes needed:
- Node: ensure AbortController abort triggers `req.destroy()` on underlying socket
- Python: provide `cancel()` on streaming iterator that closes response and connector
- Go: context cancel already works, but verify we cancel associated retries and backoff timers
samir: I'll open a meta-issue and list platform/runtime follow-ups. RD-2768
maya: can you also add interop tests for streaming abort in the SDK CI matrix? tiny script that starts stream then cancels after n ms and asserts server-side session gone within 5s
olivia: I'll add tests to the QA harness. will need a short ttl env var to avoid flakiness
ci-bot: build #5421 failed on `sdk-node` after change — see https://ci.internal/reports/5421
samir: pinging @alex for PR review — PR adds `signal` passthrough and socket destroy on abort: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-node/pull/198
alex: review now. left one comment about `eventEmitter` leak. will approve after fix
ryan: also planning runtime tweak: reduce forced flush timeout to 3s if client abort flag present. will open runtime PR RD-2775
maya: thx all. can we get an ETA? repurpose next sprint? need for a customer on dedicated
alex: aiming for SDK fixes + tests in 2 working days, runtime change by end of week. will update RD-2768 with timeline
samir: assigning tasks in RD-2768: sdk-node (alex), sdk-python (samir), sdk-go (jen), runtime (ryan), qa (olivia)
maya: perfect. please @mention me on PRs. :thumbsup:
